questions.question:
**Select the word that is nearest in meaning to the word given in capitals.**

Agony
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**pain**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the given words and their meaning.
 
• **Agony**: extreme physical or mental suffering.
 
• **Pain**: A state of suffering of the body or mind.
 
• **Help**: making it easier for someone to do something by offering one's services or resources
 
• **Risk**: exposure to danger, harm, or loss
 
• **Blame**: responsibility for a fault or wrong
 
• Hence, the correct synonym of **agony **is **pain**
 
• **Example**: *The war veteran after getting injured on the battlefield exclaimed "Every moment I breathe is an agony__"*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** *

 
• The **synonyms **of **agony **are: anguish, misery, torture, woe, and distress.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The office was __rife__ with rumours.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**widespread"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rife **can be used to describe a situation or condition that is characterized by the presence of something in a high degree or abundance. ("प्रचंड" का उपयोग किसी ऐसी स्थिति का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जा सकता है जो किसी चीज़ की उच्च डिग्री या बहुतायत में उपस्थिति की विशेषता है।)

 
 
• ***Example**: The area was rife with poverty and unemployment.*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words**__

__
 
• **Restive** is used to describe someone or something that is unwilling to remain in a particular situation, position, or condition, and is showing signs of impatience, resistance or dissatisfaction. (रेस्टिव का उपयोग किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति या किसी चीज़ का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है जो किसी विशेष स्थिति में रहने के लिए तैयार नहीं है, और अधीरता, प्रतिरोध या असंतोष के लक्षण दिखा रहा है।)

 
 
• ***Example**: The crowd grew **restive** as the speaker went over their allotted time.*
 
 
 
• **Widespread** is used to describe something that is present or occurring over a large area or among a large number of people or things. (व्यापक का उपयोग किसी ऐसी चीज का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है जो किसी बड़े क्षेत्र में या बड़ी संख्या में लोगों या चीजों के बीच मौजूद या घटित होती है।)
 
 
• ***Example**: The use of smartphones has become **widespread** among all age groups.*
 
 
 
• **Shake** can refer to the act of moving back and forth or up and down rapidly, often as a result of an earthquake, a vibration, or a force being applied. (आगे और पीछे या तेजी से ऊपर और नीचे जाने की क्रिया को संदर्भित कर सकता है, अक्सर भूकंप, कंपन या बल लागू होने के परिणामस्वरूप।)
 
 
• ***Example**: The building **shook** during the earthquake.*
 
 
 
• **Troublesome** is used to describe something or someone that is causing difficulty, problems, or inconvenience. It implies that the thing or person in question is causing trouble, or is likely to cause trouble in the future. (परेशानी" का उपयोग किसी ऐसी चीज या किसी व्यक्ति का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है जो कठिनाई, समस्याएं या असुविधा पैदा कर रहा है। इसका तात्पर्य है कि वह वस्तु या व्यक्ति समस्या पैदा कर रहा है, या भविष्य में परेशानी का कारण बन सकता है।)
 
 
• ***Example**: The new software was causing a **troublesome** problem in the system.*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words,** *the correct answer is **Option 2, i.e., widespread.***

questions.question: Select the synonym of **to permeate**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'to imbue'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **To permeate**__**: **To spread or flow throughout; pervade

 __
 
• **E.g.**__- Rain water **permeates** through the ground.
 
 
 
• __**To imbue**__**: To fill somebody/something with deep feelings, strong opinions, or ideas**
 __
 
• E.g.__- His books are **imbued** with his radical political beliefs.**​**
 
 

**​Hence, **the correct answer is **'to imbue'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Torrid**__**: Full of or involving strong emotions, especially connected with love and sex**

 __
 
• **​**E.g.__- Their **torrid** romance is the talk of the town.
 
 
 
• __**Stale**__**: (U****sed for food or air) old and not fresh anymore**
 __
 
• **​**​E.g.__- The bread will go **stale** if you don’t put it away.
 
 
 
• __**To desiccate**__**: To remove the moisture from something so it becomes completely dry**
 __
 
• **​**E.g.__- Intensive farming has **desiccated** the land. ** ** ** ** ** **
